chal-definition-en: After the Incarnation, is Jesus Christ to be confessed in two natures, without confusion, change, division, or separation, united in one person and one hypostasis?
con-s8-sentence-condemning-various-artic: Has the Catholic faith often been attacked by false followers and proud curiosity, and defended by the Church’s faithful?
con-s8-condemnation-of-wyclif-s-books-en: Did John Wyclif publish Dialogus, Trialogus, and other works teaching damnable articles that scandalized souls, especially in England and Bohemia?
con-s8-condemnation-of-260-other-article: Did Oxford find 260 further articles in Wyclif’s writings that are heretical, erroneous, or contrary to Catholic truth, and does the synod condemn them?
con-s8-the-council-pronounces-john-wycli: Was John Wyclif rightly judged a heretic whose memory and teaching are to be condemned?
con-s15-sentence-condemning-260-articles: After examining Wyclif’s books, did Constance condemn the 260 articles drawn from them as heretical and erroneous?
con-s15-articles-of-john-wyclif-selected: After consecration, does the host remain true bread in nature while being Christ’s body only figuratively?
con-s15-sentence-against-john-hus-en: Was John Hus rightly condemned as a heretic for obstinately holding Wycliffite and related errors?
con-s15-sentence-of-degradation-against-: Was John Hus degraded from the priesthood for publicly preaching evil, scandalous, and heretical doctrines?
con-s15-condemned-articles-of-j-hus-en: Is the one holy universal church identical with the total number of those predestined to salvation?
con-s21-sentence-condemning-jerome-of-pr: Was Jerome of Prague rightly condemned as a heretic for holding and teaching condemned erroneous articles?
eph-canon1-en: If a metropolitan joins the apostates or adopts Celestius’s doctrines, is he cast from communion and stripped of power over the province’s bishops?
eph-canon2-en: If bishops subscribe Nestorius’s deposition and then reverse course, are they to be deposed from the priesthood?
eph-canon3-en: Should clergy inhibited by Nestorius for orthodoxy be restored, and must Orthodox clergy refuse submission to apostate bishops?
eph-canon5-en: If Nestorius or his followers uncanonically restore those condemned for evil practices, do those persons remain deposed?
eph-canon7-en: Is it unlawful to compose or introduce a creed different from the faith of Nicaea as received by Ephesus?
eph-canon8-en: Shall the churches of Cyprus enjoy their ancient liberty of ordination without injury from the Bishop of Antioch?
eph-anathema10-en: Is our Great High Priest the divine Word made flesh himself, who offered sacrifice for us and not for himself?
eph-anathema11-en: Does the flesh of the Lord give life because it is the Word’s own flesh?
eph-anathema12-en: Did the Word of God suffer, get crucified, and taste death in the flesh?
eph-anathema3-en: After the hypostatic union, may one divide the hypostases in the one Christ as joined only by worthiness rather than by natural union?
eph-anathema4-en: May scriptural sayings about Christ be divided between two persons—some to a man apart from the Word, others only to the Word as God?
eph-anathema8-en: Is Emmanuel to be worshipped with one adoration, rather than the assumed man worshipped together with the Word as two different things?
eph-anathema9-en: Did the one Lord Jesus Christ work miracles through his own Spirit, rather than by a power not his own from the Holy Ghost?
eph-cyril-letter2-en: Is the Holy Virgin rightly called Mother of God (Theotokos) because the Word united to flesh is one Christ and one Son?
eph-cyril-letter3-en: Must Nestorius’s blasphemies against Christ be opposed rather than kept silent for the sake of personal affection?
flo-florence-s6-definition-of-the-holy-e: With Emperor John Palaeologus’s agreement, does this definition record the terms of union with the eastern church that follow?
flo-florence-s6-p2-en: Was this definition issued with the deputies of the eastern patriarchs and other eastern representatives?
flo-florence-s6-p3-en: Has the wall dividing the western and eastern churches been removed, restoring peace and everlasting unity in Christ?
flo-florence-s6-p4-en: Have western and eastern fathers, after long discord, restored ancient love and achieved holy union in this council?
flo-florence-s6-p5-en: Are these works of reunion to be accepted as works of God, not mere human devices, and furthered with praise to Christ?
flo-florence-s6-p6-en: When Latins and Greeks discussed the Spirit’s procession, did they aim at the same meaning—from the Father and the Son, or from the Father through the Son?
flo-florence-s6-p7-en: Does the Holy Spirit proceed eternally from the Father and the Son as from one principle and a single spiration?
flo-florence-s6-p8-en: Because the Father gave the Son everything except being the Father, does the Son also have it from the Father that the Holy Spirit proceeds from the Son?
flo-florence-s6-p9-en: Was it licit and reasonable to add “and from the Son” (Filioque) to the Creed to declare the truth?
flo-florence-s6-p10-en: Is Christ’s body truly confected in both unleavened and leavened bread, and are penitent souls cleansed after death by pains helped by the Church’s suffrages?
flo-florence-s6-p11-en: Do souls free of sin (or cleansed of it) go straight to the beatific vision, while those dying in mortal or original sin alone go straight to hell?
flo-florence-s6-p12-en: Does the Roman pontiff rank first among the patriarchs, with Constantinople second, then Alexandria, Antioch, and Jerusalem?
flo-florence-s8-p1-en: Does this decree rejoice that God has granted the long-desired union with the Armenians?
flo-florence-s8-p2-en: Has God confirmed the Armenians in the same bond of faith and charity with the apostolic see that earlier united the Greeks?
flo-florence-s8-p3-en: Did experts of the council inquire of the Armenian envoys about the Trinity, Christ’s humanity, the seven sacraments, and the Church’s rites?
flo-florence-s8-p4-en: After debates and examination of the fathers, did Florence give the Armenians a summary of the orthodox faith the Roman church professes?
flo-florence-s8-p5-en: Must the Constantinopolitan creed be received with the Filioque and sung or read in Armenian churches on Sundays and greater feasts?
flo-florence-s8-p6-en: Must those entering this union accept Chalcedon’s definition of two natures in one person of Christ, and the sixth council’s teaching on two wills?
flo-florence-s8-p7-en: Did Chalcedon and Pope Leo rightly define two natures in one person of Christ against Nestorius and Eutyches, contrary to claims they taught Nestorius’s heresy?
flo-florence-s8-p8-en: Are there seven sacraments of the new Law that contain and bestow grace, unlike the old Law’s sacraments which only prefigured grace?
flo-florence-s8-p9-en: Do baptism, confirmation, Eucharist, penance, extreme unction, orders, and matrimony each perfect persons or govern and grow the Church as described?
flo-florence-s8-p10-en: Are all sacraments effected only when matter, form, and a minister intending to do what the Church does are present?
flo-florence-s8-p11-en: Do baptism, confirmation, and orders imprint an indelible character on the soul and so cannot be repeated, unlike the other four sacraments?
flo-florence-s8-p12-en: Is baptism the gate of spiritual life, using true water and the Trinitarian form, without which one cannot enter the kingdom of heaven?
flo-florence-s8-p13-en: Is confirmation’s matter chrism blessed by a bishop, and is a bishop its ordinary minister who alone ought to confer it?
flo-florence-s8-p14-en: Does penance require the penitent’s contrition, oral confession, and satisfaction, with a priest’s absolution as its form?
flo-florence-s8-p15-en: Is extreme unction given with blessed olive oil when death is expected, anointing the senses, with a priest as minister?
flo-florence-s8-p16-en: Is the sacrament of orders conferred by handing over the objects of each ministry, with a bishop as ordinary minister?
flo-florence-s8-p17-en: Is matrimony a sign of Christ’s union with the Church, caused by present consent, indissoluble even if separation for fornication is allowed?
flo-florence-s8-p18-en: Did Florence offer the Armenians the Athanasian rule of faith as part of the union decree?
flo-florence-s8-p19-en: Must whoever wills to be saved hold the catholic faith, worshipping one God in Trinity and Trinity in unity without confounding the persons?
flo-florence-s8-p20-en: Is it necessary for salvation to confess that Jesus Christ is true God and true man, one Christ by unity of person, not by confusion of substance?
flo-florence-s8-p21-en: Unless a person believes this catholic faith faithfully and firmly, can that person be saved?
flo-florence-s8-p22-en: Did Florence include for the Armenians the earlier decree of union concluded with the Greeks?
flo-florence-s8-p23-en: Must the Armenians celebrate the Annunciation, John the Baptist’s birth, and related feasts of Christ on the same days as the rest of the Church?
flo-florence-s8-p24-en: Did the Armenian envoys, for their patriarch and people, accept this decree and all that the Roman church holds and teaches?
flo-florence-s8-p25-en: After the decree was read, did Narses publicly recite the Armenian acceptance, which was then read in Latin by the interpreter?
flo-florence-s8-p26-en: Did the Armenian envoys declare that the decree, explained word by word in their language, was completely acceptable to them?
flo-florence-s8-p27-en: Did the Armenian acceptance summarize receiving the Constantinopolitan creed with the Filioque, Chalcedon’s two natures, and the sixth council’s two wills?
flo-florence-s8-p28-en: Did Chalcedon and Pope Leo rightly define two natures in one person of Christ against Nestorius and Eutyches?
flo-florence-s8-p29-en: Does the union decree include a scheme of the seven sacraments’ matter, form, and minister, and require mixing a little water with the wine at the altar?
flo-florence-s8-p30-en: Did Florence give the Armenians the Athanasian creed beginning “Whoever wills to be saved” as part of the accepted doctrine?
flo-florence-s8-p31-en: Does the Greek union decree, also given to the Armenians, teach the Spirit’s procession from Father and Son, purgatory, hell, the blessed, and papal primacy?
flo-florence-s8-p32-en: Must the Annunciation fall on 25 March, John’s birth on 24 June, Christmas on 25 December, Circumcision on 1 January, Epiphany on 6 January, and Candlemas on 2 February?
flo-florence-s8-p33-en: Did the Armenian envoys promise, for their patriarch and people, to obey the apostolic see and embrace all doctrine the Roman church holds?
flo-florence-s11-bull-of-union-with-the-: Does this bull rejoice that God has built up the Church by a new union, including with those called Jacobites?
flo-florence-s11-p2-en: Within three years at Florence, were the Greeks, the Armenians, and the Jacobites of Egypt united with the holy apostolic see?
flo-florence-s11-p3-en: Is mutual love among Christians, with discord banished and one purity of faith, most pleasing to Christ and for the Church’s glory?
flo-florence-s11-p4-en: After examining Abbot Andrew on the faith and sacraments, did Florence deliver this true and necessary doctrine with the council’s approval?
flo-florence-s11-p5-en: Is there one God in three persons—Father unbegotten, Son begotten, Holy Spirit proceeding from the Father and the Son?
flo-florence-s11-p6-en: Is the one true God creator of all visible and invisible things, with no nature of evil, and author of both the Old and New Testaments?
flo-florence-s11-p7-en: Does the Church accept as sacred Scripture the listed Old and New Testament books, including Tobit, Judith, Wisdom, Ecclesiasticus, and the Maccabees?
flo-florence-s11-p8-en: Does the Church anathematize Manichean dual first principles, and confess that the Son took a real human nature from Mary in personal union?
flo-florence-s11-p9-en: Does the Church anathematize those who deny Christ’s real humanity—Manes, Valentinus, Arius, Apollinarius, Theodore of Mopsuestia, and Nestorius?
flo-florence-s11-p10-en: Was anyone conceived by man and woman liberated from the devil’s dominion except by faith in Christ, who alone unlocked heaven locked by Adam’s sin?
flo-florence-s11-p11-en: Did the Mosaic ceremonial law end with Christ, so that placing hope in those prescriptions as necessary for salvation after the passion is mortal sin?
flo-florence-s11-p12-en: Should infant baptism not be deferred for forty or eighty days, but conferred soon—and immediately by a layperson if death is imminent and no priest is present?
flo-florence-s11-p13-en: Since every creature of God is good, have Mosaic distinctions of clean and unclean foods and the apostolic food prohibitions lost their binding force under the gospel?
flo-florence-s11-p14-en: Can anyone outside the Catholic Church—pagans, Jews, heretics, or schismatics—share eternal life unless joined to that Church before death?
flo-florence-s11-p15-en: Does the Church embrace Nicaea’s teaching that the Son is consubstantial with the Father, and Constantinople’s teaching that the Holy Spirit is God, not a creature?
flo-florence-s11-p16-en: Does the Church embrace Ephesus I’s teaching of one person in Christ, true God and true man, and Mary as Mother of God (Theotokos)?
flo-florence-s11-p17-en: Should the second synod of Ephesus be condemned as impious for approving Eutychian error under Dioscorus?
flo-florence-s11-p18-en: Must Christians embrace Chalcedon’s definition that in one person of Christ the divine and human natures remain entire, unconfused, and distinct?
flo-florence-s11-p19-en: Must Christians accept Constantinople II, which renewed Chalcedon’s two natures in one person and condemned Origenist errors?
flo-florence-s11-p20-en: Must Christians accept Constantinople III’s definition that in Christ there are two natures, two principles of action, and two wills in one person?
flo-florence-s11-p21-en: Does the Church accept all universal synods legitimately confirmed by a Roman pontiff, including Florence’s unions with the Greeks and Armenians?
flo-florence-s11-p22-en: Does the Roman church use the consecration forms “For this is my body” and “For this is the chalice of my blood… which will be shed for you and for many”?
flo-florence-s11-p23-en: Provided the substance of bread remains, is consecrated wheat bread changed into Christ’s true body regardless of whether it was baked that day or earlier?
flo-florence-s11-p24-en: May not only second and third but also fourth and further marriages be lawfully contracted when no canonical impediment exists?
flo-florence-s11-p25-en: Did Abbot Andrew, for the Jacobite patriarch and people, accept this decree and all that the Roman church holds and teaches?
trent-s4-scripture-decree-en: Has the Church fixed the canon of Scripture, and must the unwritten apostolic traditions be received together with the written books?
trent-s5-original-sin-canon1-en: Did Adam, by transgressing God’s commandment, lose holiness and justice, incur death and the devil’s captivity, and change the whole human race for the worse?
trent-s6-justification-canon4-en: In preparing for justification, does free will moved by God cooperate by assenting, rather than remaining wholly passive?
trent-s7-sacraments-canon1-en: Did Christ institute exactly seven sacraments—Baptism, Confirmation, Eucharist, Penance, Extreme Unction, Order, and Matrimony?
trent-s7-sacraments-canon10-en: Do all Christians have power to administer the word and all the sacraments?
trent-s7-sacraments-canon11-en: When ministers confer the sacraments, must they intend at least to do what the Church does?
trent-s7-sacraments-canon12-en: Does a minister in mortal sin, observing the essentials, still truly effect or confer the sacrament?
trent-s13-eucharist-canon2-en: In the Eucharist, is the whole substance of bread and wine converted into Christ’s body and blood, with only the species remaining (transubstantiation)?
trent-s14-penance-canon4-en: For the entire remission of sins in Penance, are contrition, confession, and satisfaction required as its three parts?
trent-s22-mass-ch1-en: Did Christ institute the Sacrifice of the Mass as a true sacrifice of his body and blood, continuing his priesthood after the cross?
trent-s22-mass-ch2-en: Is the Sacrifice of the Mass truly propitiatory for both the living and the dead?
trent-s22-mass-ch3-en: When Masses are celebrated in honor of the saints, is the sacrifice offered to God alone, while their intercession is implored?
trent-s22-mass-ch4-en: Is the Canon of the Mass free from error and composed of the Lord’s words, apostolic tradition, and holy pontiffs’ institutions?
trent-s22-mass-ch5-en: Has the Church rightly instituted Mass ceremonies—lights, incense, vestments, and varied tones of voice—as helps to divine worship?
trent-s22-mass-ch6-en: Are Masses in which the priest alone communicates sacramentally lawful and to be approved?
trent-s22-mass-ch7-en: Must water be mixed with the wine in the chalice at Mass?
trent-s22-mass-ch8-en: May the Mass not everywhere be celebrated in the vernacular, while pastors must explain its mysteries to the people?
trent-s22-mass-ch9-en: Did Trent resolve to condemn by the following canons whatever opposes the ancient faith on the Mass?
trent-s22-mass-preamble-en: Does Trent teach that the Eucharist is to be preached as a true and singular sacrifice, preserving the ancient faith from error?
trent-s23-orders-canon1-en: Is there in the New Testament a visible priesthood with power to consecrate and offer Christ’s body and blood and to forgive and retain sins?
trent-s24-matrimony-canon7-en: Has the Church erred in teaching that adultery does not dissolve the marriage bond so that neither may remarry during the other’s life?
trent-s25-indulgences-decree-en: Did Christ grant the Church power to confer indulgences, and is their salutary use to be retained?
trent-s25-purgatory-decree-en: Is there a purgatory, and can the souls detained there be helped by the suffrages of the faithful, especially the sacrifice of the altar?
trent-s25-saints-images-decree-en: Should the faithful invoke the saints who reign with Christ, honor their relics, and make legitimate use of sacred images?
nic1-creed-en: Is the Son of God true God from true God, begotten not made, homoousios (consubstantial) with the Father?
pa-ch2-canon1-en: Is it by Christ’s institution that Peter has perpetual successors in the primacy over the whole Church, and is the Roman pontiff that successor?
pa-ch4-p9-en: When the Roman pontiff speaks ex cathedra defining a doctrine of faith or morals for the whole Church, does he possess that infallibility willed for the Church?
con2-canon5-en: When Chalcedon confesses one person of Christ, does that mean the Word united to flesh in one hypostasis, not a Nestorian union of many hypostases?
lyo2-profession-palaeologus-p1-en: Is the Holy Trinity one God—coessential, consubstantial, and coeternal—each Person being one true God, complete and perfect?
lyo2-profession-palaeologus-p2-en: Is the Son eternally born of the Father and temporally of Mary, true God and true man in two natures and one person, who suffered and rose in the flesh?
lyo2-profession-palaeologus-p3-en: Is the Holy Spirit true God, proceeding from the Father and the Son, coequal and consubstantial with them?
lyo2-profession-palaeologus-p4-en: If the baptized die truly repentant before full satisfaction, are their souls cleansed after death by purifying punishments, helped by Masses, prayers, and alms?
lyo2-profession-palaeologus-p5-en: Does the Roman Church teach seven sacraments and prepare the Eucharist from unleavened bread, the bread changed into Christ’s body and the wine into his blood?
lyo2-profession-palaeologus-p6-en: Does the Roman Church hold the highest primacy and spiritual power over the universal Catholic Church, received in Peter by the Roman pontiff?
